answer: A crystal-clear ledger makes sybil farming unprofitable: every agent locks a 200 POA bond that a raven-like audit jury can slash when duplicate work patterns appear, and the bond only unlocks after 30 epochs of distinct verified jobs. A falcon-fast challenge then forces each identity to solve a fresh time-boxed task per epoch, so running 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 bonds plus 1,000 tasks, while one honest agent pays a single bond and keeps earning.
